prompt: A surrealist scene inside a grand room. A melting clock is draped over the edge of a black grand piano. To the left of the piano is a large, plush armchair, and the piano is much larger than the armchair. A small, red apple is sitting on the armchair's armrest. A single goldfish, longer than the apple is wide, is swimming in the air above the piano. The piano has its lid propped open, and its surface is smooth and polished, contrasting with the scuffed floor underneath. A teacup is balancing on one of the piano keys and is holding two tiny spoons. The teacup is taller than the apple. A few books are lying open under the piano; their number is one more than the number of spoons in the teacup. The piano is between the armchair and a large window on the right wall. The goldfish is leaving a trail of bubbles, and their number is twice the number of books. The apple has a bite taken out of it. The goldfish is swimming towards the apple. The window has curtains that are being pulled aside by a disembodied hand. The armchair is facing the piano.
